d: We are a dynamic and fast-growing AI & IT company specialising in cutting-edge technology solutions for businesses of all sizes. As we continue to expand, we are seeking a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and motivated Human Resources Specialist to join our team.

We are seeking an experienced HR Specialist to coordinate end-to-end HR operations, recruitment, onboarding, and offboarding across our entities in GCC and Middle East. The role focuses on maintaining accurate HR documentation and HRIS system, records, coordinating compliance with applicable labour laws, improving HR processes, and providing operational HR support and guidance to management and line managers.
q: Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration or a related field.
Professional HR certification (CHRP / CHRM, SHRM-CP/SCP or equivalent) preferred.
3-5 years of HR experience, including at least 2 years in a generalist or specialist operations role in the UAE.
Experience preferably in the IT & AI, Fintech or Outsourcing sector, supporting a large employee base.
Proven end-to-end ownership of recruitment, onboarding and offboarding.
Experience with multi-country HR across the GCC and Middle East is a strong advantage.
Proficient in HRIS management, including employee data uploads, system configuration, reporting, troubleshooting and user support.
Strong working knowledge of GCC and Middle East labour regulations.
Accurate calculation of end-of-service gratuity and final settlements by country.
Ability to write and localise HR policies, SOPs, contracts and letters.
Advanced Excel and MS Office skills; comfortable building trackers and reports.
Sound judgement, discretion and integrity with confidential information.
Process improvement mindset; Lean Six Sigma knowledge is an advantage.
Send your CV to recruitment@dalil.tech and be part of the region’s digital transformation.

By applying for this role, you consent to the collection and processing of your personal data in accordance with the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 (PDPL). Your information will be used only for recruitment purposes, kept secure, and retained only as long as necessary. You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting our HR Department.
Your data will not be shared with third parties except where required for recruitment and with appropriate safeguards
r: li

li

li
Assist with monthly payroll, salary adjustments, benefits, leave administration, statutory contributions, and final settlements with Finance.
li
Coordinate visas, work permits, medical insurance, renewals, cancellations, and other government-related requirements.
li
Support compliance with applicable labour laws, company policies, and regulatory requirements across all entities.
li
Support employee relations, grievances, disciplinary matters, and HR-related queries.
li
Assist with HR process improvements, HRIS enhancements, employee engagement initiatives, and policy updates.

d: We are seeking an experienced Vmware & Nutanix SME to support and manage enterprise infrastructure environments across VMware, Nutanix, Microsoft Azure, and Windows Server platforms. The role involves day-to-day operations, administration, troubleshooting, lifecycle management, and automation, while ensuring high availability of critical infrastructure services.
q: BSc in Telecommunications, Computer Science, or equivalent.
8–10 years of IT infrastructure operations experience.
Minimum 6 years of hands-on VMware administration experience and minimum of 3 years each in Nutanix and Microsoft Azure administration.
Experience in VMware: ESXi and vCenter administration, HA/DRS, VM provisioning, patching, performance, capacity, and security management.
Experience in Nutanix: Prism Central and Prism Element, AHV administration, Lifecycle Manager (LCM), capacity monitoring, and data protection.
Experience in Microsoft Azure: Virtual machines, virtual networks, storage, monitoring, backup, identity and access management, security, and governance.
Experience in Windows Server: DNS, DHCP, file services, patching, security management, performance monitoring, and PowerShell scripting.
Infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Ansible, or Terraform is a plus.
Azure Automation and Azure Monitor is a plus.
Monitoring tools such as SCOM or HP Service Assurance is a plus.
ITIL Foundation, VMware VCP, Nutanix NCP, or Microsoft AZ-104 certifications is a plus.
Ability to manage critical incidents and high-pressure production environments.
Customer-focused with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Proactive, detail-oriented, with strong ownership and operational discipline.
